Description: Canonical Tier 1/Tier 2 Store-fallback map. Sealed package-family identities are the preferred local re-registration route. Each removal-list package also has exactly one fallback entry; StoreId is empty when no current Store identity has been verified. ExpectedPackageNames must exist after Store fallback. DeprovisionedStoreId/DeprovisionedExpectedPackageNames name a Store product verified only after Tier 1 removed the package for the whole device; only Tier 1 inventories carry it. Every Store product below was measured on 22 October 2026 (Windows 11 Home 26H2, WinGet 1.29.290): after removal for the user with the package still staged, or for every user when it is not preinstalled, WinGet msstore installed it and the same package family registered. Catalog v3.5 and earlier stay restorable from Bloatware-Catalog-v3.5.json.

Microsoft.BingNews.ReplacementNote: Tier 2 removes the app only for the user and leaves its package staged; a Store install then fails with ERROR_PACKAGE_ALREADY_EXISTS (0x80073CFB), so Tier 2 claims only sealed local package-family re-registration. Tier 1 removes the package for the whole device; local re-registration then fails with ERROR_INSTALL_FAILED (0x80073CF9) and Store product 9WZDNCRFHVFW installs and registers through WinGet msstore (measured on Windows 11 Enterprise 26H2 with WinGet 1.29.380). Only Tier 1 inventories therefore carry this Store product.

Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection.ReplacementNote: The current Storefront still exposes product 9WZDNCRFHWD2, but release-gate WinGet 1.29.280 msstore exact ID, name and locale queries return NO_APPLICATIONS_FOUND. Only sealed local package-family re-registration is claimed until WinGet exposes a verified fallback again.

Microsoft.XboxApp.ReplacementNote: The retired Xbox Console Companion is replaced by the current Xbox app; this cannot recreate the former package.

Microsoft.Xbox.TCUI.ReplacementNote: Tier 2 removes the component only for the user and leaves its package staged, so Tier 2 claims only sealed local package-family re-registration. Tier 1 removes the package for the whole device; Store product 9NKNC0LD5NN6 (Xbox TCUI) then installs and registers through WinGet msstore, which delivered a newer package than the inbox one (measured on Windows 11 Enterprise 26H2 with region Germany and WinGet 1.29.380 on 13 October 2026). The Store app opens the product page only through its direct link, not through search. Only Tier 1 inventories therefore carry this Store product.
